style: 3D animation, tall vertical frame edge to edge, deadpan slapstick satire
subject: ONE hunched hyena in a bright blue work shirt and battered boots, left sole torn loose and flapping, right sole worn through with two round holes, yellow-callused toes poking out, long grin, running on the spot inside the wheel
second_characters: ONE black vulture on the rim, never touching the hyena

props.bill: ONE long blank white paper strip on the vulture's spool

environment: inside the wheel: orange slats, spokes, paper scraps, close
lighting: hard midday sun pouring into the open wheel from behind him, high contrast, sunlit orange slats bounce warm light on his face; orange wheel, blue shirt, black vulture, white paper

light_events.event: sun behind his boot shoots two bright beams through the sole holes into the lens

motion_rule: the camera orbits the hyena without pause in EVERY beat, new shot size every beat, waist to close and back. He fills at least half the frame height. The wheel always spins under him. Slats, paper and coins fly into the lens.

audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, native, no accent
audio.pacing: 4.6 syllables per second, each line once, fits its beat

timeline.a: mouth opens each syllable; close on his chest, he pounds the wheel, the loose sole slapping like a jaw, slats fly into the lens, orbiting left
the loose sole snags on a slat, he stumbles, flings up both forepaws and catches the stride, orbiting right, waist shot
mouth opens each syllable; he hunches lower, pounding harder, the vulture unrolls the blank strip from his spool into the lens, orbiting left, close shot
he jerks a look over his shoulder; the vulture slaps the strip onto the wheel and it winds under his boots, orbiting right, waist shot
the vulture flicks the coin into the wheel, it rings off a spoke and the vulture catches it in his beak; he grabs empty air, orbiting left, close shot
mouth opens each syllable; a too wide grin to the lens, not missing a step, the vulture tucks the coin under his wing, scraps fly into the lens, orbiting right, waist shot
the wound paper hooks his leg, he hops on one hind paw, staying in the wheel, orbiting left, close shot
mouth opens each syllable; on one leg he lifts his right boot sole to the lens beside his face: two round holes worn through, toes with yellow calluses poking out, orbiting right, close shot
he shoves the same holed sole right into the lens, half the frame, daylight through its two holes, toes wiggling, grin above, orbiting left
he yanks the strip's end off the vulture's spool and bites off a piece with a clack, orbiting right, waist shot
he stuffs the piece into his holed boot as an insole, the beams through the holes vanish, he stamps on the rim, orbiting left, close shot
wide pleased grin into the lens, face close and large, the wheel spinning under him, tapping the patched boot on the rim, orbiting right

must_appear: 0.00 flapping loose sole, chest filling the frame; 6.20 sole with two through holes beside his face; 7.50 sole in the lens, light through holes; 8.75 piece of the bill in the boot; 9.40 face into the lens
negative_prompt: a crowd, text, letters, digits on props, captions, subtitles, logos, speech bubbles, watermark, darkness, horizontal frame, letterbox, static camera, someone touching the hyena during speech, slow speech, drawn-out delivery, English speech, foreign accent, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, a third character, character changing appearance, eye macro
